meta.title: 벚꽃 정류장
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (벚꽃 정류장, a coming-of-age webtoon (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: An anime background painting: a deep-to-pale sky #1F5FC8 to #7FC4F2 warming to #FFE8C8 at the horizon, white cumulus shaded blue-grey #B9C7E6 underneath, cherry pinks #FFC3D7, #F49BBB and #FFE4EE, a blue bus-stop sign #2E6FD8, a green city bus; a golden-hour variant for the end.
rationale.type: Gowun Dodum, a gentle rounded Korean face, in white with a soft blue shadow over the sky, fading up line by line.
rationale.motion: Unhurried: a tilt down from the sky, a slow push-in, clouds drifting, petals falling and flipping, a gust when the bus arrives; the light is the event: rays and a flare from the sun.
rationale.sound: Corporate-lite at 112 BPM in D major (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s), strings and piano, a gentle kit; glassy SFX: chimes on the title and the bus.
rationale.visuals: All code: cumulus from shaded puffs, a sun with rays and lens ghosts, power lines on a pole, a cherry tree of pink clusters, petals, a street, a bus stop with an arrival board, two students seen from behind, a bus.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: two lines of text carry it.
